text.card: A red giant 4,666 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.86 solar masses and 17.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,354 K at its surface.
